item.title: Rodney Ingram Will Take Over the Title Role in ALADDIN
item.description: Aladdin has announced that Rodney Ingram will step into the title role beginning Tuesday, February 3. Ainsley Melham will play his final performance Sunday, February 1. Ingram made his Broadway debut understudying Aladdin in 2015 before playing the role on Broadway and also in Mexico City, where he met his wife Sonia! Other Broadway credits include Raoul in The Phantom of the Opera (30th anniversary). Regional credits include The Little Mermaid, Little Women, Children of Eden, and Master Class.

item.description: WHEN PLAYWRIGHTS KILL, a new backstage comedy by Matthew Lombardo (Tea at Five) will make its world premiere at The Huntington Theatre in Boston, Massachusetts, directed by Noah Himmelstein (Conversations With Mother). This Strictly Limited Engagement will be performed April 3 through April 18, 2026. item.description: The official trailer has been released for The Land of Sometimes, the upcoming animated feature with a star-studded cast and new songs from EGOT-winning songwriter Sir Tim Rice. item.title: Will Aronson and Hue Park Honored With ASCAP Foundation Richard Rodgers New Horizons Award
item.description: The ASCAP Foundation has recognized musical theater writing duo Will Aronson and Hue Park, creators of the Tony Award-winning musical Maybe Happy Ending, with The ASCAP Foundation Richard Rodgers New Horizons Award. The award is presented to promising composers of musical theater who have made a significant contribution to American music culture. item.title: Jonathan Bailey and Ariana Grande Confirmed to Star in SUNDAY IN THE PARK WITH GEORGE
item.description: Jonathan Bailey and Ariana Grande have been confirmed to star in a new stage production of Stephen Sondheim’s legendary musical, Sunday in the Park with George. Performances will begin at the Barbican Centre, London in Summer 2027. Sunday in the Park with George has music and lyrics by Stephen Sondheim and a book by James Lapine. item.title: Annual MLK Concert Relocates From Kennedy Center After 23 Years
item.description: The long-running Let Freedom Ring MLK concert will relocate from the Kennedy Center to the Howard Theatre in 2026, with organizers citing cost savings and broader changes at the arts institution.
